subject.title: feat(browser): My Browser node-anchored turn routing (stacks on #93411)

question: Should PR #93680 continue as a separate extension-bridge/browser-copilot architecture, or should it be rebased into the current-main driver="extension" relay from #100619 after #93411 is settled?
rationale: The current codebase now has a merged Chrome extension relay, while this PR adds a parallel driver, extension package, config surface, and security boundary that automation cannot choose between safely.

options.title: Rebase onto current relay
options.body: Use #100619's driver="extension" implementation as the canonical browser relay and extract only the unique node-routed side-panel behavior after #93411 lands.

options.title: Keep extension-bridge separate
options.body: Maintain a second browser extension architecture, but require explicit security review, narrower permissions, full config/docs alignment, and upgrade guidance before merge.

options.title: Pause or close after extraction
options.body: Close or pause this branch if the merged relay plus smaller follow-up issues cover the useful behavior with less duplicate surface.

recommendation.title: Rebase onto current relay
recommendation.body: Use #100619's driver="extension" implementation as the canonical browser relay and extract only the unique node-routed side-panel behavior after #93411 lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and the unresolved choice is product/security direction across browser, gateway, and node-host surfaces.
